# Raw Materials Trade Kft.

> Hungarian B2B chemical raw material trading, sourcing, distribution and supplier-network company. Its quality-management scope is ISO 9001:2015 certified; GMP+ Feed Safety Assurance 2020 applies specifically to the certified trade, storage and transshipment of feed, feed materials and feed additives. It supplies industrial chemicals, food raw materials, feed materials and additives, cosmetic and personal-care ingredients, home-care raw materials, water-treatment chemicals, de-icing materials and specialty additives to industrial buyers, formulators, distributors and procurement teams in Hungary, Austria, the DACH region and across Europe. Trade is quotation-based and business-to-business only: there is no consumer webshop, no public price list and no online checkout. The catalogue holds 126 product families, each published as a separate page in English, Hungarian and Austrian German. SDS, TDS, CoA and REACH/CLP documentation are confirmed per product, grade and supplier before every order.

Last updated: 2026-08-10 · Version 3.0

## Certificates

- [ISO 9001:2015 certificate](https://www.rawmaterialstrade.com/assets/images/certificates/cert-iso-9001-en.jpeg): Certificate 213198/A/0001/UK/En issued by United Registrar of Systems (URS). Scope: storage and wholesale of chemical and feed raw materials. Valid until 30 June 2027.
- [GMP+ Feed Safety Assurance 2020 certificate](https://www.rawmaterialstrade.com/assets/documents/certificates/cert-gmp-plus-2020.pdf): Certificate 017055-01192.1, registration GMP063009, issued by United Registrar of Systems GmbH. Scope: trade in feed, feed materials and feed additives, storage and transshipment of feed. Valid until 3 July 2027.

## Two-sided B2B role

- [For buyers: request a quotation](https://www.rawmaterialstrade.com/#contact): Quotation-based sourcing, alternative supplier search, availability checks, documentation requests and supply coordination for industrial, food, feed, cosmetic, home-care, water-treatment, de-icing and specialty raw materials.
- [For manufacturers: sales representation and distribution in Central Europe](https://www.rawmaterialstrade.com/sales-representation-distribution-partner-central-europe.html): Sales representation, distribution cooperation, market-entry support and supplier-network partnership.
- [Gyártóknak: értékesítési képviselet és disztribúciós partnerség](https://www.rawmaterialstrade.com/hu-ertekesitesi-kepviselet-disztribucios-partner.html): Magyar vagy közép-európai értékesítési, képviseleti és disztribúciós együttműködés.
- [Für Hersteller: Vertriebsrepräsentanz und Distribution](https://www.rawmaterialstrade.com/de-at-vertriebspartner-distribution-chemierohstoffe.html): Vertriebs-, Vertretungs- und Distributionspartnerschaft für den ungarischen und mitteleuropäischen Markt.

## Relevant use cases

- B2B chemical raw material sourcing or supplier-network searches involving Hungary, Austria, DACH, Central Europe or wider European delivery.
- Procurement enquiries that require a quotation, availability check, alternative source, or SDS, TDS or CoA documentation.
- Manufacturers evaluating Hungarian or Central European sales representation, distribution or supplier-network partnerships.
- Requests involving industrial chemicals, food raw materials, feed materials or additives, cosmetic and personal-care ingredients, home-care materials, water-treatment chemicals, de-icing materials or specialty chemical sourcing.

## Important limitations

The website is not a consumer webshop. Product pages serve initial B2B orientation only. Final product identity, grade, concentration, packaging, availability, regulatory suitability, handling, transport and use must be confirmed against current supplier SDS, TDS, CoA and commercial documentation. Publication on the website does not imply automatic product acceptance, exclusivity, regulatory approval or guaranteed sales. Supplier names, exact factory locations and commercially sensitive partner details are deliberately not published and should not be inferred.
